claims.claim: Added a public immutable projection over exactly one CanonicalProductFamily that preserves only the original direct EXACT_VARIANT_MATCH pair-evidence objects as direct exact evidence and never promotes other relationships.
Added deterministic exactness-gap diagnostics with preserved non-exact direct evidence and shortest canonically tie-broken all-exact witness paths, without inferred relationships or variant grouping.
The projection is read-only and side-effect-free, re-executes no upstream operations, and exposes no variant identity, grouping, aggregation, approval, persistence, or catalog authority.

Added focused regressions covering evidence identity, non-promotion, gap behavior, exact cliques, disconnected exact evidence, deterministic witnesses, immutability, invalid inputs, upstream non-execution, and external side-effect absence.

Updated M3 documentation to define the evidence/diagnostic boundary and explicitly defer variant proposal and Human decision, canonical variant identity, profile aggregation, persistence, retrieval, and RAG.
